crossAdapterPolicy.purpose: Allow a demonstrably better adapter-specific structural solution to run before the standard structural protocol on sites with a certified current contract, without weakening the universal safety boundary.
crossAdapterPolicy.eligibility: Site identity alone is insufficient. A specialized runner is eligible only when the reviewed site identity and current structural capability/signature checks satisfy that runner's certified contract; failed, stale, clipped, ambiguous, or missing verification demotes immediately to the next safer runner.
crossAdapterPolicy.authorityBoundary: Reviewed input/Send actuation authority is separate from structural mount authority. No platform inherits ChatGPT's insertion slot or another platform's structural runner by analogy.
